package: SFN 3 x 3 mm, 5 pads on one side + exposed pad

footprint_drawing.exposed_pad: 2.10 x 2.55 on the footprint (package 2.0-2.2 x 2.4-2.6), 8 plated vias 0.2 mm at 0.5 pitch, tented or plugged

circuit.role: bus pull-ups R1/R2 in Melexis' example

logic: -000 option = 3.3 V I2C (VIH 0.7 VDD). The -100 option is the 1.8 V I2C version (3 in stock: not used). p5, p9

i2c_addr.select: ADDR pin sets bit 0 (GND 0x3A, VDD 0x3B); upper bits in EEPROM 0x24D5 (p21)

placement: Looks out through an OPEN hole (or a far-infrared window: thin HDPE or silicon [mem]; glass, acrylic and polycarbonate are opaque at 5-14 um). Field of view 50 deg (p1): the hole wall must stay outside the cone and the target must fill it (p2).
Away from heat and thermal gradients: not near the brain, charger, converters or the gas heater; even ground copper around it. Accuracy is specified in thermal equilibrium (p2).
Exposed pad to ground with the 8 vias (p46).
notes: DCB = medical accuracy grade: object range limited to -20..100 C (p2).
Sleep by register; 1.5 uA typ. No switched rail needed.
